purpose: The 1M+fast production profile: million-token context with the measured fast-prefill buffers (ggerganov's canonical DGX Spark config, ~434 tok/s prefill vs ~208 at ub=256). Two 512k slots protect the agent conversation cache from utility-call eviction; a single request is therefore capped at 512k tokens. The context-scaled compute buffers at CTX=1M/ub=2048 leave a measured steady state of ~9.8 GiB free (memwatch BREACH 2026-08-01), so the owner accepted lowering the watchdog floor to 8 GiB - a deliberately thinner crash barrier. The 12 GiB overhead charge is the measured non-weight, non-KV footprint (~11.3 GiB) at this exact configuration.

safety.note: enforced inside scripts/21_serve_llamacpp.sh via the env above; the delegate owns admission, watchdog, and weights verification

memory_model.basis: kv 6.9 KiB/token analytic (docs/bigctx plan; the delegate's historical 4096 B/token admission constant is known-undersized and is not used for estimation); overhead 12 GiB measured at CTX=1M/ub=2048
